transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?

Um, hi. Yeah, thanks for seeing me. I guess… I’ve just been having a hard time letting go of this feeling at work. I’m a buyer, and I keep thinking people there—like coworkers, and even some vendors—are tracking what I’m buying and messing with the launch numbers so I look stupid.

I know that probably sounds kind of… intense. My supervisor has shown me reports that don’t really prove anything like that is happening, but I still can’t shake it. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but it’s been bothering me enough that I thought I should come in.
How long have you been having these thoughts about your coworkers and vendors tracking your purchases and messing with the numbers?

Um… I guess it’s been about ten months, give or take. It didn’t feel like a big thing at first, or I tried not to make it one, but those thoughts have kind of been around since then. The voice too… if that matters.
You mentioned 'the voice'—can you tell me more about that? Do you actually hear a voice speaking to you or about you when no one else is around?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, but sometimes I do hear it. Like if I’m in the stockroom, or driving back from a vendor meeting, I’ll hear a man’s voice like it’s right behind me.

It’ll say something like, “Move faster, Scott,” or kind of laugh at what I picked. And I’ll turn around, or check, and there’s nobody there. It’s not all the time, but… yeah, that’s what I meant by the voice.

During these past ten months, have you also gone through stretches where your mood was very high, irritable, or energized—or on the other end, very low or depressed—that lasted for days or weeks at a time?

Yeah… I mean, I think so. I don’t know if I’d call it “very” high, but I do get these stretches where I feel like everything is opening up for me, like the whole city is kind of… there for me, if that makes sense.

And then if someone at work questions a purchase order or tells me to slow down, I can snap at them way harder than I mean to. I’m not trying to be difficult or anything. It just comes out stronger than I expected.

When your mood is back to normal—not feeling high or irritable—do you still hear that voice or have those thoughts about coworkers tracking you, or do those experiences only happen during the times your mood is elevated?

I wish I could say it only happens when I’m all keyed up, but… not really. There was a calmer stretch where I was sleeping more normally and I didn’t feel like I was, you know, running the whole market or anything.

But even then, for a few weeks, I still thought people were tracking my buys, and I’d still hear that voice in the stockroom sometimes. Not constantly, but it was there. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Over these past 10 months, roughly how many total weeks would you say you had the voice or the tracking thoughts while your mood was completely normal—not high, irritable, or low?

Um… I’d say a few weeks total. Maybe like… two or three? I don’t want to overstate it.

That was during the calmer stretch, when I was sleeping more normally and not feeling so keyed up. But even then I still had the thought that people were tracking my buys, and I heard the voice in the stockroom sometimes. Not constantly, but enough that I noticed it. Does that answer it the right way?

Out of these full 10 months, roughly how many weeks or months would you say you were experiencing those high or irritable (or low) mood periods, compared to the total time you've had these thoughts and voice?

Yeah… I think most of it, honestly, was during those wired or irritable stretches. I don’t want to make it sound like I was out of control the whole time, but looking back, a lot of the ten months was me overworking, feeling really sure of myself, like I could handle more than everyone thought, and getting annoyed when people tried to slow me down.

There were calmer periods in between, but they were shorter. So compared to the voice and the tracking thoughts overall, I’d say the mood stuff was there for most of that time since it started. Is that the kind of estimate you mean?
